_comment: USD per 1M tokens. Hand-edited in a PR. A model absent here keeps its token counts and reports usd_estimated: null — see scripts/lib/token-cost.mjs. Sourced 2026-07-31 (#1197 review, finding I6) from Anthropic's published pricing (platform.claude.com/docs/en/pricing) and Google's public Gemini pricing page — re-verify before trusting a number more than a few months old. claude-sonnet-5 is priced at its standing list rate ($3/$15 per 1M); Anthropic may also run an introductory $2/$10 rate through 2026-08-31 that this table does not track, so a run priced during that window is a slight over-estimate, never an under-estimate. gemini-flash-latest is priced the same as gemini-2.5-flash — the model class the alias currently resolves to on Langflow 1.12.0.dev10 (measured: the trace's modelName is the bare alias, not a dated id) — re-check this row if the alias moves to a newer Gemini generation.
